subtitles.text:
Whoever helps him is
named in the same FIR—

The name they
write will be mine.

For the first time,
this uniform fits, madam.

In my force,
we don't wear a medal like this.

Come back and
collect your medal.

I have not taken it out
in two years, madam.
My phone stays in your pocket.

Come in, come in,
Inspector sahab.

Why has the shutter been
brought down, Bhaiyaji?

Big load today, Inspector sahab.
Let no eye fall on it.

The truck is full, Bhaiyaji.
Sacks up to the tarpaulin.

It goes over the
crossing tonight itself.

Kindly show me the slip,
Bhaiyaji.

But SHO sahab has already
signed this slip, Bhaiyaji...

Then why was I
invited here at all?
it's you I was waiting for.

And whose phone is this,
in your pocket?
